query:
SELECT o.name, o.slug, 
  COUNT(DISTINCT ova.ventureId) as venture_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks t WHERE t.ventureId IN (SELECT ventureId FROM org_venture_access WHERE organizationId = o.id)) as task_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM distributions d WHERE d.organizationId = o.id) as dist_count
FROM organizations o
LEFT JOIN org_venture_access ova ON ova.organizationId = o.id
WHERE o.status = 'active'
GROUP BY o.id, o.name, o.slug
ORDER BY venture_count DESC
